characters.jung: Jung Bahadur Kunwar: stern Nepali general in his late 20s, thick black moustache, jewelled crown-helmet topped with tall bird-of-paradise plumes, ornate gold-embroidered dark 19th-century military coat, curved sword

shots.name: bg_kot_night
shots.subject: the Kot courtyard beside Hanuman Dhoka palace, empty stone square ringed by Newari pagoda buildings
shots.action: armed soldiers wait silently in the shadows at the gates

camera.angle: low angle from the courtyard floor

shots.lighting: flickering wall torches as the key light, cold blue moonlight as rim from above
shots.palette: teal-black shadows, amber torch pools, no saturated colours
shots.theme: power is about to change hands violently
shots.composition: courtyard centre and right, dark open sky in the upper-left third left empty for the title
details: wet brick paving reflecting the torches
shots.focal: the torch-lit palace gate at the far side of the courtyard
shots.hook: a single armed silhouette framed in the glowing gateway

shots.name: ct_khukuri
shots.subject: a traditional Nepali khukuri knife with a curved blade
shots.material: hand-forged steel blade, horn handle with brass bolster
shots.condition: blade edge stained with dark dried blood
details: visible hammer marks on the blade

items.name: ct_royal_seal
items.subject: a red wax royal seal with a lion emblem

items.name: ct_oil_lamp
items.subject: a brass Nepali oil lamp (diyo) with a small flame

items.name: ct_scroll
items.subject: a rolled parchment decree tied with red cord

shots.name: vid_kot_dawn
shots.subject: the blood-stained Kot courtyard at dawn after the massacre
shots.action: smoke drifts across fallen swords while Jung Bahadur steps out of a doorway
shots.lighting: cold blue dawn ambience, last embers of torches as warm accents
shots.palette: steel blue, ash grey, dried-blood maroon

beats.action: empty courtyard, smoke drifting over fallen swords
Jung Bahadur steps into the doorway light and stops
he looks across the courtyard, plumes moving slightly in the wind

shots.sound: distant crows, wind, a single bell far away
shots.hook: his plumed helmet catching the first light
